# Meridian Future Academy (MFA)

> Meridian Future Academy is a Cognia-accredited, independent U.S. secondary school
> serving Grades 9-12. Academic headquarters: 2 Cobblestone Cir, Wayland, MA 01778, USA
> (Boston area). Operational headquarters: Singapore. Formerly known as Wayland Academy.
> 子午线未来学院是一所 Cognia 认证的美国中学，面向 9–12 年级，学术总部位于波士顿，运营总部位于新加坡。

## Key facts
- Accreditation: Cognia (world's largest education accreditation community)
- Diploma: independent U.S. high-school diploma, globally recognized
- CEEB code: 050551
- Grading: U.S. 4.0 GPA system; official transcripts issued from Massachusetts
- Graduation: 21-24 credits incl. Scientific Literacy, AI Literacy and a PBL Capstone
- Technology: Canvas LMS, JupiterED SIS, AI English Classroom, AI tools for teachers; LIOS in development
- Talent programs: dedicated tracks for student-athletes and young musicians
- Pathways: universities in 15+ countries (US, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong China, etc.)
- Contact: info@meridianfuture.org / admissions@meridianfuture.org / +1-213-290-3817
- Student portal: https://mfa.canvaslms.net
- Languages: English (root) and Simplified Chinese (/zh/), cross-linked via hreflang
